name: sip-match-menu
description: Cocktail recommendation engine. 3-question flow, discriminated union types, locale-agnostic i18n engine, WCAG 2.1 AA. Bilingual ES/EN.

paragraphs: An interactive cocktail menu with a preference-based recommendation engine — guides customers to their ideal drink in 3 questions or fewer.

Most bar menus are passive catalogues. A customer scans a QR code, faces 30+ options with no guidance, enters decision paralysis, and either orders "the usual" or nothing at all — both outcomes cap the ticket and waste the table's engagement window.

SipMatch is built to convert that moment. A preference-based recommendation engine (the Quiz) guides the user to their ideal drink in 3 questions or fewer — reducing decision friction, increasing order confidence, and nudging customers toward cocktails they might not have discovered otherwise. The result is a higher average ticket and lower churn per interaction.
features: The quiz is the core conversion mechanism. It collects up to 3 preference signals and maps them to a filtered cocktail shortlist — functioning as a lightweight, rule-based recommender that mirrors the logic of a…
Occasion — Aperitif / Evening & Night / With a meal / Dessert
Flavor style — Bold & Classic / Refreshing & Light / Sweet & Fruity
Spirit preference — multi-select from spirits available in the filtered subset
